revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - lin5 εὐθυμοῦση: remove accent or change to acute (in general, the treatment of such forms is unsystematic) || lin16 <:γρηΐα|reg|γρύα:> => <:γραῖα|reg|γρύα:> (γρηΰς is an Ionic and poetic form) || lines 18 & 22 κυριοῦ => κυρίου
Submit - removed mistaken correction in l. 13 on behalf of Cisca Hoogendijk
Vote - AcceptText - Lin4 on the published image the left half of the omicron can be seen. Lin13 on the published image the Pi instead of Tau is indeed the better reading.

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. lin4 yes, agree ; lin13 yes, agree ; for (orig.) I prefer (autopsy) ; need to include diacriticals for origs throughout: lin13=> κυρίῳ ; 14=⟩ Πέτ̣ρ̣ου ; 14=⟩ τῇ ; 14,19=⟩ θυγατρός ; 16=⟩ γρύα ; 22=⟩ κυρία ; 18=⟩ τοῦ , κυρίου , Πέτρου ; 22=⟩ κυρία ; τ[ὸν]|reg|τ̣[οῦ] , κυρίου . As to the Qn, encoding is correct, but XSLT bug seems to be eliding the upsilon. For lin16,24=> κατ*apostrophe*

Made some corrections on the original. Question: why do I see 'υϊου papyrus' in app. l. 18, but only 'ϊου papyrus' in app. l. 10? I would have liked to show that the apostrophe after κατ' in lines 16 and 24 is written on the papyrus, but cannot find the appropriate symbol.
